subject.title: tools.exec.approvalRunningNoticeMs is documented but rejected by the 2026.3.24 config schema

question: Should maintainers resolve the open fork PR by adopting/rebasing/replacing it, or close it before queueing a narrow same-repo schema repair?
rationale: The source fix is clear, but the open fork PR uses closing syntax, is conflicting, is not maintainer-editable, and contains unrelated stale changes, so automation should not silently create a duplicate repair path.

options.title: Replace with narrow schema repair
options.body: Close or supersede the stale fork branch and land only the shared schema, generated-schema, and regression-test fix.

options.title: Wait for contributor rebase
options.body: Ask the fork author to rebase, drop unrelated daemon changes, enable maintainer edits, and add current proof before review continues.

options.title: Remove the documented key
options.body: If maintainers no longer want this knob, remove the docs/help/type/runtime reads instead of accepting the config path.

recommendation.title: Replace with narrow schema repair
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the stale fork branch and land only the shared schema, generated-schema, and regression-test fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The history ties this config surface and schema refactor to steipete, and CONTRIBUTING.md lists the handle as a maintainer who can make the cleanup call.
